pass_predicates.llvm_verify: opt -passes=verify returns 0 on the final candidate
pass_predicates.entrypoint: llvm-nm reports the configured public entrypoint as externally visible and defined
pass_predicates.bundle_link: the finalization bundle creates a non-empty executable and records its SHA-256
pass_predicates.behavior: all registered valid-domain executions match the reference observation tuple with zero mismatch, zero inconclusive and no early stop
pass_predicates.native_contract: the strict final native-contract reporter returns zero violations
pass_predicates.native_compile: the final IR links as an executable without the McSema compatibility runtime

authority_classes.validated_compat: all structural gates and the behavioral gate pass, but one or more native gates do not pass
authority_classes.evidence_only: the candidate passes LLVM verification but lacks complete behavioral or structural authority
